content.title: Kinetic Text | Barriers Shatter in Sequence
content.summary: In a desaturated world, short words become physical obstacles on the route. The protagonist breaks them one by one through forward movements, restoring part of the color with each impact, and finally names the new state with an original short sentence.

quick_start.input_format: Inhibited environment baseline + 2 short word entity obstacles + protagonist advancing to crush + restoring environmental state each time + an original ending sentence
quick_start.recommended_input: The delivery drone passes through the gray logistics tunnel, smashing the entity words DELAY and HOLD in sequence. Each impact restores a section of route lights, and finally stops in the loading area and the short sentence ROUTE CLEAR appears.
required_anchors: Start by establishing a suppressed environment state
Short words must occupy real route space
Obstacles can only be broken by the protagonist's forward movement
Each smash restores the visible environment state
Only use an original sentence to name the result at the end.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: In a desaturated world, short words become physical obstacles on the route. The protagonist breaks them one by one through forward movements, restoring part of the color with each impact, and finally names the new state with an original short sentence.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Begin in a visually suppressed world, bind one short word or phrase to a physical obstacle in the subject's route, and require the subject's forward action to break that obstacle rather than merely passing it. Each break restores a visible part of the world; finish with one original concise statement that names the achieved state, not the source slogan.

invariants.rule: Begin with one visibly suppressed environmental state.
invariants.purpose: Creates a measurable baseline for recovery.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a baseline, color restoration has no consequence.

invariants.rule: Turn a short readable word into a real obstacle on the route.
invariants.ablation_failure: Floating captions do not participate in causality.

invariants.rule: Require forward subject action to break each obstacle.
invariants.ablation_failure: Passive explosions detach the change from the protagonist.

invariants.rule: Make each break restore a visible part of the environment.
invariants.ablation_failure: If nothing changes, repeated breaks feel interchangeable.

invariants.rule: End with one original concise statement describing the achieved state.
invariants.purpose: Provides a readable payoff without copying a slogan.
invariants.ablation_failure: A long motivational paragraph overwhelms the visual result.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: BREAK THE STATIC / RUN YOUR DAY
